t: The one with the least of it
a: إِنَّ أَدْنَى أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ مَنْزِلَةً رَجُلٌ صَرَفَ اللَّهُ وَجْهَهُ عَنِ النَّارِ قِبَلَ الْجَنَّةِ وَمَثَّلَ لَهُ شَجَرَةً ذَاتَ ظِلٍّ فَقَالَ أَىْ رَبِّ قَدِّمْنِي إِلَى هَذِهِ الشَّجَرَةِ أَكُونُ فِي ظِلِّهَا
m: He says: my Lord, bring me forward to that tree so I may be in its shade and drink of its water. Allah asks: if I give you that, will you ask for anything else? He says no. He is brought forward, then sees a better one, and asks again, and is asked again, and promises again.
